result.title: HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations
result.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo
result.summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HorizonFlow，将 DMD 梯度中高信噪比的外观/布局成分与低信噪比的运动成分解耦，仅通过训练期回归目标修正（Chunk Evenness 均匀展开每个 latent chunk 的运动、Semantic Commitment 锚定粗布局），在 600 次迭代内把 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步视频生成模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对 latent 梯度各成分信噪比失衡的诊断，以及「保持原损失、只改回归目标以分别校正静态与动态成分」的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态训练中区分内容保持与状态更新、避免静态信息主导坍缩提供可核查的训练监督线索。
